messages.subject: Renewable Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ian,

Meridian Stone Search's boutique focus on renewable energy infrastructure and executive leadership is relevant to my experience at the intersection of resources, sustainability and institutional engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates supporting responsible growth across energy, infrastructure and resources. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
